title: Change Origin
description: What authorized a change to a media buy. Experimental in AdCP 3.3 (media_buy.seller_adjustment_allowances). Absent means the origin is not stated.

enumDescriptions.buyer: The buyer requested the change, through control_media_buy or an amendment the buyer originated.
enumDescriptions.seller_offer: The buyer accepted a seller offer (a proposal with proposal_initiator seller) through accept_proposal.
enumDescriptions.seller_allowance: The seller applied it unilaterally within a seller_adjustment_allowances entry the buyer accepted in the buy's commercial_terms. The change record names the allowance_id.
